name: Crested Boar Will

acquire.equipPiece: One pale stone tusk-guard clipped on the jaw; brown dust-kick streaks and a stone-grey impact afterimage.

integrate.transformation: Full armoured form boar-beastman: tusked snout under a stone-crest helm, bristle ridge from skull to spine, hunched boulder pauldrons, hoofed digitigrade greaved legs, a short bristled tail and a stone tusk-lance on the forearm.

equip.weapon: A long stone tusk-lance grown from the right forearm.
equip.armor: Layered rock armour: stone-crest helm, hunched boulder pauldrons, banded stone greaves, hoof-plated feet.
equip.hair_eyes: Stone-hard bristle crest from skull to spine; small deep-set amber eyes.
equip.aura: Earth-brown aura with rock-dust and pebbles kicked up at the feet.

lore: The will of a highland tusker so old its bristle crest has turned to stone: it does not dodge, it walks through the blow and gores.
pitch: The Crested Boar Elder is an A-class highland tusker whose bristle crest has turned to stone; it never dodges, it walks through the blow and gores. Acquire keeps you human with brown dust-kick streaks and one equipped piece, a stone tusk-guard on the jaw, for a hardened hide and a straight rooting rush. Integrate (Full armoured form) makes you a tusked, stone-crested boar-beastman in rock plate with a tusk-lance; it is the cheap A-rank tank with no ranged answer.
untrained: An untrained holder cannot stop: the hide stiffens joints, the charge overruns the holder's own footing and strain climbs while the crest hardens the neck. CANON ADDENDUM 2: the will lies dormant in the holder's mana core until it is forcefully awakened (a flame sparked in the core); if the holder cannot suppress and balance it, the clashing energies wreck body and core and can kill (design: strain climbs fast, backlash damage, forced cancel at the cap); mastery means training both the holder's own core and the beast core, best taught by the beast itself. This will summons no beasts or hordes.

spirit.echo: A hulking boar-beastman in rock armour: tusked blunt snout under a stone-crest helm, ridge of stone bristles from skull to spine, massive hunched boulder pauldrons, hoofed digitigrade legs, short bristled tail, a tusk-lance on the forearm.
spirit.look: A rust-brown orb crusted with ridged stone plates, two pale tusk curves wrapped round it and a dull ember glow in the cracks.
